cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 39 since November 2018. She is a certified municipal clerk, president of the Cherokee County Republican Women and vice-chair of the Cherokee County Republican Executive Committee. She previously worked with the Gadsden Airport Authority.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Ginny Shaver was born or raised, or when she came to Alabama. We found no stated positions or actions from her on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, campaign money, policing, guns, abortion or school choice. The Ballotpedia list of bills she sponsored did not load, so we could not tie any bill to her record. Ballotpedia shows no endorsements for her in 2026, and she did not complete its candidate surveys in 2022 or 2026. We found no documented controversies or foreign ties. The Wikipedia page was a short stub with no further detail.
